playwright.name: browser_close
playwright.description: Close the page

playwright.name: browser_resize
playwright.description: Resize the browser window

playwright.name: browser_console_messages
playwright.description: Returns all console messages

level.description: Level of the console messages to return. Each level includes the messages of more severe levels. Defaults to "info".

all.description: Return all console messages since the beginning of the session, not just since the last navigation. Defaults to false.

filename.description: Filename to save the console messages to. If not provided, messages are returned as text.

playwright.name: browser_handle_dialog
playwright.description: Handle a dialog

promptText.description: The text of the prompt in case of a prompt dialog.

playwright.name: browser_evaluate
playwright.description: Evaluate JavaScript expression on page or element

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

function.description: () => { /* code */ } or (element) => { /* code */ } when element is provided

filename.description: Filename to save the result to. If not provided, result is returned as text.

playwright.name: browser_file_upload
playwright.description: Upload one or multiple files

paths.description: The absolute paths to the files to upload. Can be single file or multiple files. If omitted, file chooser is cancelled.

playwright.name: browser_drop
playwright.description: Drop files or MIME-typed data onto an element, as if dragged from outside the page. At least one of "paths" or "data" must be provided.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

paths.description: Absolute paths to files to drop onto the element.

data.description: Data to drop, as a map of MIME type to string value (e.g. {"text/plain": "hello", "text/uri-list": "https://example.com"}).

annotations.title: Drop files or data onto an element

playwright.name: browser_find
playwright.description: Search the accessibility snapshot of the current page for text or a regular expression. Returns matching snapshot nodes with a few lines of surrounding context (like search snippets), each shown under its path from the root of the tree, which is cheaper than capturing the whole snapshot when you only need to locate an element and its ref.

text.description: Plain text to search for in the page snapshot (case-insensitive substring match). Provide either text or regex, not both.

regex.description: Regular expression to search for in the page snapshot. Matching is case-sensitive by default; wrap the pattern in slashes to add flags, e.g. "/error/i" for case-insensitive. Provide either text or regex, not both.

playwright.name: browser_fill_form
playwright.description: Fill multiple form fields

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

value.description: Value to fill in the field. If the field is a checkbox, the value should be `true` or `false`. If the field is a combobox, the value should be the text of the option.

playwright.name: browser_press_key
playwright.description: Press a key on the keyboard

key.description: Name of the key to press or a character to generate, such as `ArrowLeft` or `a`

playwright.name: browser_type
playwright.description: Type text into editable element

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

text.description: Text to type into the element

submit.description: Whether to submit entered text (press Enter after)

slowly.description: Whether to type one character at a time. Useful for triggering key handlers in the page. By default entire text is filled in at once.

playwright.name: browser_mouse_move_xy
playwright.description: Move mouse to a given position

playwright.name: browser_mouse_click_xy
playwright.description: Click mouse button at a given position

button.description: Button to click, defaults to left

delay.description: Time to wait between mouse down and mouse up in milliseconds, defaults to 0

playwright.name: browser_mouse_drag_xy
playwright.description: Drag left mouse button to a given position

playwright.name: browser_mouse_down
playwright.description: Press mouse down

button.description: Button to press, defaults to left

playwright.name: browser_mouse_up
playwright.description: Press mouse up

button.description: Button to press, defaults to left

playwright.name: browser_mouse_wheel
playwright.description: Scroll mouse wheel

playwright.name: browser_navigate
playwright.description: Navigate to a URL

playwright.name: browser_navigate_back
playwright.description: Go back to the previous page in the history

playwright.name: browser_network_requests
playwright.description: Returns a numbered list of network requests since loading the page. Use browser_network_request with the number to get full details.

static.description: Whether to include successful static resources like images, fonts, scripts, etc. Defaults to false.

filter.description: Only return requests whose URL matches this regexp (e.g. "/api/.*user").

filename.description: Filename to save the network requests to. If not provided, requests are returned as text.

playwright.name: browser_network_request
playwright.description: Returns full details (headers and body) of a single network request, or a single part if `part` is set. Use the number from browser_network_requests.

index.description: 1-based index of the request, as printed by browser_network_requests.

part.description: Return only this part of the request. Omit to return full details.

filename.description: Filename to save the result to. If not provided, output is returned as text.

playwright.name: browser_pdf_save
playwright.description: Save page as PDF

filename.description: File name to save the pdf to. Defaults to `page-{timestamp}.pdf` if not specified. Prefer relative file names to stay within the output directory.

playwright.name: browser_run_code_unsafe
playwright.description: Run a Playwright code snippet. Unsafe: executes arbitrary JavaScript in the Playwright server process and is RCE-equivalent.

code.description: A JavaScript function containing Playwright code to execute. It will be invoked with a single argument, page, which you can use for any page interaction. For example: `async (page) => { await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click(); return await page.title(); }`

filename.description: Load code from the specified file. If both code and filename are provided, code will be ignored.

playwright.name: browser_take_screenshot
playwright.description: Take a screenshot of the current page. You can't perform actions based on the screenshot, use browser_snapshot for actions.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

type.description: Image format for the screenshot. If unset, inferred from the filename extension, otherwise png.

filename.description: File name to save the screenshot to. Defaults to `page-{timestamp}.{png|jpeg|webp}` if not specified. Prefer relative file names to stay within the output directory.

fullPage.description: When true, takes a screenshot of the full scrollable page, instead of the currently visible viewport. Cannot be used with element screenshots.

scale.description: Image resolution scale. "css" produces a screenshot sized in CSS pixels (smaller, consistent across devices). "device" produces a high-resolution screenshot using device pixels (larger, accounts for the device pixel ratio). Default is css.

playwright.name: browser_snapshot
playwright.description: Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page, this is better than screenshot

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

filename.description: Save snapshot to markdown file instead of returning it in the response.

depth.description: Limit the depth of the snapshot tree

boxes.description: Include each element's bounding box as [box=x,y,width,height] in the snapshot. Coordinates are viewport-relative, in CSS pixels (Element.getBoundingClientRect)

playwright.name: browser_click
playwright.description: Perform click on a web page

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

doubleClick.description: Whether to perform a double click instead of a single click

button.description: Button to click, defaults to left

playwright.name: browser_drag
playwright.description: Perform drag and drop between two elements

startElement.description: Human-readable source element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

startTarget.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

endElement.description: Human-readable target element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

endTarget.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

playwright.name: browser_hover
playwright.description: Hover over element on page

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

playwright.name: browser_select_option
playwright.description: Select an option in a dropdown

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

values.description: Array of values to select in the dropdown. This can be a single value or multiple values.

playwright.name: browser_tabs
playwright.description: List, create, close, or select a browser tab.

index.description: Tab index, used for close/select. If omitted for close, current tab is closed.

url.description: URL to navigate to in the new tab, used for new.

playwright.name: browser_wait_for
playwright.description: Wait for text to appear or disappear or a specified time to pass

time.description: The time to wait in seconds

textGone.description: The text to wait for to disappear

desktop-mouse.name: display_size
desktop-mouse.description: Return the full X11 desktop width and height in pixels. Use this before choosing absolute mouse coordinates.

desktop-mouse.name: mouse_position
desktop-mouse.description: Return the current physical mouse cursor position on the desktop.

desktop-mouse.name: mouse_move
desktop-mouse.description: Physically move the real desktop mouse cursor to absolute X/Y screen coordinates. The cursor visibly moves on the user's XFCE desktop.

x.description: Absolute horizontal screen coordinate in pixels.

y.description: Absolute vertical screen coordinate in pixels.

duration_ms.description: Visible movement duration in milliseconds. Use approximately 250-500 ms for human-like movement.

desktop-mouse.name: mouse_move_relative
desktop-mouse.description: Physically move the real desktop cursor relative to its current location.

dx.description: Horizontal movement in pixels. Positive is right, negative is left.

dy.description: Vertical movement in pixels. Positive is down, negative is up.

desktop-mouse.name: mouse_click
desktop-mouse.description: Click the real desktop mouse at its current location. Move the cursor first if necessary.

desktop-mouse.name: mouse_double_click
desktop-mouse.description: Double-click the real mouse at the current cursor position.

desktop-mouse.name: mouse_down
desktop-mouse.description: Hold down a physical mouse button. Use mouse_up afterward.

desktop-mouse.name: mouse_up
desktop-mouse.description: Release a physical mouse button previously held with mouse_down.

desktop-mouse.name: mouse_scroll
desktop-mouse.description: Scroll the desktop at the current cursor position. Positive clicks scroll down and negative clicks scroll up.

clicks.description: Positive = scroll down. Negative = scroll up.

desktop-mouse.name: mouse_drag_to
desktop-mouse.description: Drag something with the real mouse from the current cursor position to an absolute X/Y destination.

desktop-mouse.name: mouse_release_all
desktop-mouse.description: Emergency recovery tool that releases the left, middle, and right mouse buttons if one was accidentally left held down.

desktop-vision.name: desktop_screen_info
desktop-vision.description: Return desktop dimensions and the current physical mouse cursor coordinates without taking a screenshot.

desktop-vision.name: desktop_screenshot
desktop-vision.description: Take a screenshot of the entire physical XFCE desktop and return it as an image to the vision model. Use this before moving/clicking the mouse when the location of an interface element is unknown.

max_width.description: Maximum returned image width. 1536 preserves this laptop's full desktop width.

quality.description: JPEG quality. Higher quality helps read small interface text.

show_cursor.description: Draw a small marker over the real physical cursor position.

desktop-vision.name: desktop_screenshot_region
desktop-vision.description: Take a high-resolution screenshot of a rectangular region of the desktop. Useful after a full screenshot when the model needs to inspect a menu, dialog, small button, text area, or other detailed interface region.

desktop-keyboard.name: keyboard_type_text
desktop-keyboard.description: Type text through the real X11 keyboard into the currently focused application. Use this for ordinary text. For large blocks or Unicode-heavy text, use keyboard_paste_text.

desktop-keyboard.name: keyboard_paste_text
desktop-keyboard.description: Paste a block of text into the currently focused application using the X11 clipboard and Ctrl+V. This is faster and more reliable for large or Unicode text. The previous clipboard is restored afterward when possible.

desktop-keyboard.name: keyboard_press_key
desktop-keyboard.description: Press and release a keyboard key on the real XFCE desktop. Examples: Enter, Escape, Tab, BackSpace, Delete, Left, Right, Up, Down, F1 through F12.

desktop-keyboard.name: keyboard_hotkey
desktop-keyboard.description: Press a keyboard shortcut on the real desktop. Examples: ['ctrl','l'], ['ctrl','c'], ['ctrl','shift','t'], ['alt','Tab'], ['ctrl','alt','t'].

desktop-keyboard.name: keyboard_key_down
desktop-keyboard.description: Hold down a real keyboard key or modifier. Always release it afterward with keyboard_key_up.

desktop-keyboard.name: keyboard_key_up
desktop-keyboard.description: Release a key previously held with keyboard_key_down.

desktop-keyboard.name: keyboard_release_modifiers
desktop-keyboard.description: Emergency recovery tool. Releases common modifier keys if one becomes stuck after interrupted automation.

desktop-apps.name: application_launch
desktop-apps.description: Launch an installed graphical application asynchronously. This returns without waiting for the GUI process to exit.

desktop-apps.name: window_active
desktop-apps.description: Return the currently focused graphical window.

desktop-apps.name: window_geometry
desktop-apps.description: Return exact screen position, dimensions, and center coordinates of a desktop window. Prefer this over guessing window coordinates from screenshots.

desktop-apps.name: window_focus
desktop-apps.description: Focus and bring an existing graphical window to front.

desktop-apps.name: window_close
desktop-apps.description: Request normal closure of a graphical window.

terminal-files.name: filesystem_list
terminal-files.description: List files and folders inside a directory under the user's HOME directory.

terminal-files.name: filesystem_stat
terminal-files.description: Return metadata about a file or directory under HOME.

terminal-files.name: filesystem_read_text
terminal-files.description: Read a UTF-8 text file under HOME. Intended for source code, configuration, logs and documents stored as plain text.

terminal-files.name: filesystem_write_text
terminal-files.description: Create or replace a UTF-8 text file under HOME. Parent directory must already exist.

terminal-files.name: filesystem_append_text
terminal-files.description: Append UTF-8 text to a file under HOME.

terminal-files.name: filesystem_create_directory
terminal-files.description: Create a directory under HOME, including parent directories if needed.

terminal-files.name: filesystem_copy
terminal-files.description: Copy one regular file to another location under HOME.

terminal-files.name: filesystem_move
terminal-files.description: Move or rename a file or folder within HOME.

terminal-files.name: filesystem_trash
terminal-files.description: Move a file or folder under HOME to the desktop Trash instead of permanently deleting it.

terminal-files.name: filesystem_search
terminal-files.description: Search for filenames under a directory inside HOME.

terminal-files.name: shell_environment
terminal-files.description: Return useful information about the local shell environment.

terminal-files.name: shell_which
terminal-files.description: Find the executable path for an installed command without executing it.

terminal-files.name: shell_run
terminal-files.description: Run a non-root shell command locally. The working directory must remain inside HOME. Use for compiling, testing, package-manager operations that do not require root, scripts, git, development tools, diagnostics and normal user commands.
